Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Required for Voxtral transcription and Mistral text processing. Validating also loads the Mistral text models available to this key.
Settings.StreamResponsesDescription: Render Mistral prompt-action output token-by-token as it is generated, instead of waiting for the full reply.
Settings.TemperatureModeDescription: Provider default sends no temperature, so Mistral uses each model's own default; custom sends the value below.
Settings.TemperatureValueDescription: From 0 to 1.5. Lower values give more consistent results. Used only with the custom temperature mode.
Settings.TemperatureInvalid: Enter a temperature from 0 to 1.5 using a decimal point.
Settings.ApiKeyValidFetchedTextModels: API key is valid. Loaded {0} Mistral text model(s) available to this account.
Settings.ModelRefreshFailed: Could not load Mistral text models: {0} The saved model list is unchanged.
Settings.ModelRefreshStale: The API key changed while models were loading. Validate again.
Errors.ModelCatalogInvalid: Mistral returned an invalid or oversized model list, or one without text models.
Settings.NotConfiguredMistralApiKeyRequi: Plugin not configured. Mistral API key required.
Manifest.Name: Voxtral
Manifest.Description: Voxtral (Mistral) audio transcription and Mistral text processing
